# Kaggle Labour market prediction

## Initial Setup and dependency loading

```{r, echo=FALSE}
# Initial setup, dependency loading, and data preparation, as well as splitting the data into a training and validation set so that I don't have to use up submissions

library(httpgd)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(glmnet)
library(randomForest)
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(ROCR)

# Setting the seed so that we have reproducible results
set.seed(2026)

# Visualization of the data
train_data <- read.csv("data/train.csv")
test_data <- read.csv("data/test.csv")

head(train_data)
head(test_data)

# Split training data into training and validation sets (60/40 split)
# Cleaning data by removing rows with no employed statuses since we can't make inference on those 66 removed, 11375 unemployed, 5278 employed
table(train_data$employed_status, useNA = "ifany")
train_data <- train_data[!is.na(train_data$employed_status), ] 
# Group-based split by anonymised_id (prevents participant data leakage)
unique_ids <- unique(train_data$anonymised_id)
train_ids <- sample(unique_ids, size = floor(0.6 * length(unique_ids)))

training_set <- train_data %>% filter(anonymised_id %in% train_ids)
validation_set <- train_data %>% filter(!anonymised_id %in% train_ids)

# Save validation set for later testing
write.csv(validation_set, "data/validation_set.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("Training set size:", nrow(training_set), "\n")
cat("Validation set size:", nrow(validation_set), "\n")
cat("Employment rate in training:", mean(training_set$employed_status), "\n")
cat("Employment rate in validation:", mean(validation_set$employed_status), "\n")
```

```{r}
cat("\n========== MATRIC PERFORMANCE ==========\n")

# Function to analyze matric subjects
analyze_matric <- function(data, subject_col) {
  if(subject_col %in% names(data)) {
    cat(paste0("\n--- ", subject_col, " ---\n"))
    dist <- table(data[[subject_col]], useNA = "ifany")
    print(dist)
    
    # Convert to numeric for analysis
    get_band_score <- function(x) {
      if(is.na(x)) return(NA)
      if(x == "0 - 9 %") return(5)
      if(x == "10 - 19 %") return(15)
      if(x == "20 - 29 %") return(25)
      if(x == "30 - 39 %") return(35)
      if(x == "40 - 49 %") return(45)
      if(x == "50 - 59 %") return(55)
      if(x == "60 - 69 %") return(65)
      if(x == "70 - 79 %") return(75)
      if(x == "80 - 89 %") return(85)
      if(x == "90 - 100 %") return(95)
      return(NA)
    }
    
    data[[paste0(subject_col, "_numeric")]] <- sapply(data[[subject_col]], get_band_score)
    
    # Boxplot by employment
    p_matric <- ggplot(data, aes(x = factor(employed_status), 
                                y = .data[[paste0(subject_col, "_numeric")]], 
                                fill = factor(employed_status))) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      labs(title = paste(subject_col, "by Employment Status"),
           x = "Employed", y = "Score") +
      theme_minimal()
    print(p_matric)
  }
}

cat("\n========== SUMMARY STATISTICS BY EMPLOYMENT STATUS ==========\n")

# Function to compare numeric variables
compare_by_employment <- function(data, var_name) {
  if(var_name %in% names(data) && is.numeric(data[[var_name]])) {
    stats <- data %>%
      group_by(employed_status) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean = mean(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = median(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        SD = sd(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = min(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = max(.data[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE),
        N = sum(!is.na(.data[[var_name]]))
      )
    
    cat(paste0("\n--- ", var_name, " ---\n"))
    print(stats)
  }
}

for(var in key_vars) {
```

# Bootstrapping

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(boot)

# 1. Clean Data & Merge Sparse Race Levels
training_set_clean <- training_set %>%
  mutate(
    # Merge Unspecified into Other to eliminate instability/high bias
    race = ifelse(race %in% c("Unspecified", "Other") | is.na(race), "Other", as.character(race)),
    age_under_21 = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age < 21, 1, 0),
    age_prime = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age >= 25 & age <= 29, 1, 0),
    is_wc_gauteng = ifelse(!is.na(province) & province %in% c("Western Cape", "Gauteng"), 1, 0),
    quintile_top = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 5, 1, 0),
    quintile_bottom = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 1, 1, 0),
    has_matric = ifelse(education_schooling_grade_twelve_equiv %in% c(1, "TRUE", TRUE), 1, 0),
    sample_group = case_when(
      grepl("Round 3", sample) ~ "Round_3",
      grepl("Round 4", sample) ~ "Round_4",
      grepl("Round5|Round 5", sample) ~ "Round_5",
      grepl("Round6|Round 6", sample) ~ "Round_6",
      grepl("Round7|Round 7", sample) ~ "Round_7",
      grepl("Round8|Round 8", sample) ~ "Round_8",
      TRUE ~ "Baseline_Other"
    ),
    work_readiness_score = ifelse(is.na(work_readiness_score), median(work_readiness_score, na.rm = TRUE), work_readiness_score),
    days_since_last_obs = ifelse(is.na(days_since_last_obs), median(days_since_last_obs, na.rm = TRUE), days_since_last_obs),
    total_historical_rounds = ifelse(is.na(total_historical_rounds), 0, total_historical_rounds),
    employed_lag = ifelse(is.na(employed_lag), 0, employed_lag)
  )

# 2. Refit Model with Cleaned Parameters
mle_model <- glm(
  employed_status ~ age_under_21 + age_prime + gender + race + 
    is_wc_gauteng + has_matric + quintile_top + quintile_bottom + 
    employed_lag + days_since_last_obs + total_historical_rounds + 
    work_readiness_score + sample_group,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  data = training_set_clean
)

# Extract aligned coefficient vector names
master_coef_names <- names(coef(mle_model))

# 3. Robust Bootstrap Simulation
get_coefficients_safe <- function(data, indices) {
  d <- data[indices, ]
  
  fit <- tryCatch(
    glm(
      employed_status ~ age_under_21 + age_prime + gender + race + 
        is_wc_gauteng + has_matric + quintile_top + quintile_bottom + 
        employed_lag + days_since_last_obs + total_historical_rounds + 
        work_readiness_score + sample_group,
      family = binomial(link = "logit"),
      data = d
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  
  res <- setNames(rep(NA, length(master_coef_names)), master_coef_names)
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    cf <- coef(fit)
    res[names(cf)] <- cf
  }
  return(res)
}

set.seed(123)
boot_sim <- boot(data = training_set_clean, statistic = get_coefficients_safe, R = 500)
print(boot_sim)

```


# Bootstrap Findings

```{r}
# Bind variable names directly to bootstrap estimates, bias, and std errors
boot_summary <- data.frame(
  Term = names(coef(mle_model)),
  Original_Beta = boot_sim$t0,
  Bias = colMeans(boot_sim$t, na.rm = TRUE) - boot_sim$t0,
  Std_Error = apply(boot_sim$t, 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE)
)

print(boot_summary)

```

# Writing to submission csv and comparison to VALIDATION set

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Store training set medians to prevent data leakage
train_med_work_readiness <- median(training_set$work_readiness_score, na.rm = TRUE)
train_med_days_since <- median(training_set$days_since_last_obs, na.rm = TRUE)

# 2. Preprocess validation_set strictly using training parameters
validation_set_clean <- validation_set %>%
  mutate(
    race = ifelse(race %in% c("Unspecified", "Other") | is.na(race), "Other", as.character(race)),
    age_under_21 = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age < 21, 1, 0),
    age_prime = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age >= 25 & age <= 29, 1, 0),
    is_wc_gauteng = ifelse(!is.na(province) & province %in% c("Western Cape", "Gauteng"), 1, 0),
    quintile_top = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 5, 1, 0),
    quintile_bottom = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 1, 1, 0),
    has_matric = ifelse(education_schooling_grade_twelve_equiv %in% c(1, "TRUE", TRUE), 1, 0),
    sample_group = case_when(
      grepl("Round 3", sample) ~ "Round_3",
      grepl("Round 4", sample) ~ "Round_4",
      grepl("Round5|Round 5", sample) ~ "Round_5",
      grepl("Round6|Round 6", sample) ~ "Round_6",
      grepl("Round7|Round 7", sample) ~ "Round_7",
      grepl("Round8|Round 8", sample) ~ "Round_8",
      TRUE ~ "Baseline_Other"
    ),
    work_readiness_score = ifelse(is.na(work_readiness_score), train_med_work_readiness, work_readiness_score),
    days_since_last_obs = ifelse(is.na(days_since_last_obs), train_med_days_since, days_since_last_obs),
    total_historical_rounds = ifelse(is.na(total_historical_rounds), 0, total_historical_rounds),
    employed_lag = ifelse(is.na(employed_lag), 0, employed_lag)
  )

# 3. Generate Predicted Probabilities on validation_set
val_probabilities <- predict(mle_model, newdata = validation_set_clean, type = "response")

# 4. Grid Search for Optimal Cutoff Threshold on Leak-Free Validation Set
thresholds <- seq(0.2, 0.6, by = 0.01)
best_thresh <- 0.5
best_acc <- 0

for (t in thresholds) {
  acc <- mean((val_probabilities >= t) == validation_set_clean$employed_status, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (acc > best_acc) {
    best_acc <- acc
    best_thresh <- t
  }
}

cat("Leak-Free Validation Set Accuracy:", round(best_acc * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Optimal Decision Threshold:", best_thresh, "\n")

# 1. Load the actual test file
test_data <- read.csv("data/test.csv")

# 2. Change input source from validation_set to test_data
test_data_clean <- test_data %>%
  mutate(
    race = ifelse(race %in% c("Unspecified", "Other") | is.na(race), "Other", as.character(race)),
    age_under_21 = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age < 21, 1, 0),
    age_prime = ifelse(!is.na(age) & age >= 25 & age <= 29, 1, 0),
    is_wc_gauteng = ifelse(!is.na(province) & province %in% c("Western Cape", "Gauteng"), 1, 0),
    quintile_top = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 5, 1, 0),
    quintile_bottom = ifelse(!is.na(school_quintile) & school_quintile == 1, 1, 0),
    has_matric = ifelse(education_schooling_grade_twelve_equiv %in% c(1, "TRUE", TRUE), 1, 0),
    sample_group = case_when(
      grepl("Round 3", sample) ~ "Round_3",
      grepl("Round 4", sample) ~ "Round_4",
      grepl("Round5|Round 5", sample) ~ "Round_5",
      grepl("Round6|Round 6", sample) ~ "Round_6",
      grepl("Round7|Round 7", sample) ~ "Round_7",
      grepl("Round8|Round 8", sample) ~ "Round_8",
      TRUE ~ "Baseline_Other"
    ),
    work_readiness_score = ifelse(is.na(work_readiness_score), train_med_work_readiness, work_readiness_score),
    days_since_last_obs = ifelse(is.na(days_since_last_obs), train_med_days_since, days_since_last_obs),
    total_historical_rounds = ifelse(is.na(total_historical_rounds), 0, total_historical_rounds),
    employed_lag = ifelse(is.na(employed_lag), 0, employed_lag)
  )

# 3. Predict on test_data_clean instead of validation_set_clean
test_probabilities <- predict(mle_model, newdata = test_data_clean, type = "response")

# 4. Extract IDs directly from test_data_clean
submission <- data.frame(
  anonymised_id = test_data_clean$anonymised_id,
  employed_status = test_probabilities
)

write.csv(submission, "submission.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
